validated_results.title: Dietary intake of micronutrients and the risk of developing bladder cancer: results from the Belgian case-control study on bladder cancer risk.
validated_results.reason: This population-based case-control study evaluates dietary magnesium intake and incident bladder cancer risk with fully adjusted odds ratios.

extraction.population: Belgian case-control study on bladder cancer risk in Limburg province

design.excerpt: Briefly, our study was a population-based case–control study conducted in the Belgian province of Limburg consisting of 200 bladder cancer cases and 386 healthy control subjects

timing.excerpt: Participants were asked to report their usual dietary intake for the 12 months prior to the interview.

continent.excerpt: A semi-quantitative 322 item food frequency questionnaire (FFQ) was used to collect dietary data from 200 bladder cancer cases and 386 control subjects participating in the Belgian case–control study on bladder cancer risk.

exposure_measurement.excerpt: The IMMIDIET standardized food frequency questionnaire (FFQ) was sent by mail to all participants in the study.

extraction.ethnicity_basis: Default: no protocol-mapped specific country or population was established
